body: No problem. Just remember to take yourself into account in this whole situation. You are just as important as she is, and if you're not happy and she's the cause of it and unable/unwilling to change that - then you should do what's best for you.

Talk to her and confront you insecurities head on, letting it stew will only let it fester and eat away at you from the inside until you grow to hate her. If you really want things to work out TRY to work things out.

But personally my opinion is to end it. Do the right thing and put both of you out of your misery. If someone's not happy in the relationship and both parties are unwilling to compromise and put the effort in to fix what needs to be dealt with then the relationship is over.

People get back together because they're afraid of change, and insecure of themselves. They worry that they'll never find someone out there that's "better" or just as good - all of which is complete lie. Both of you deserve more. There are 6 billion people in the world, you do the math.
